description: S457 "6a": the `url` named shape refuses a non-safe scheme in the BOUNDARY zone. show(link: string(url)) is called first with "https://scrml.dev/" (a safe scheme — the check passes, @shown takes it) and then with "JaVaScRiPt:alert(1)" (the URL parser accepts it; its scheme, read case-insensitively, is `javascript`, outside the §5.2 safe set). The compiler-generated boundary check throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT before the assignment, so @shown RETAINS the https value. (E-CONTRACT-001-RT is a runtime error, not a compile code; the observable is the retained prior value.)
rationale: §53.6.1: every scheme outside `http`/`https`/`ftp`/`mailto`/`tel`/`sms` "SHALL fail the predicate" and "a boundary-zone value that fails it raises `E-CONTRACT-001-RT` (§53.4.5)"; §53.3.3: the variable retains its prior value.
